about: Who narrates explainer clips. A clip names its map zone (the island ids in game/ui/map.gd) and is narrated by that zone's teacher; recordings go in game/assets/audio/voice/<teacher>/clips/<clip id>/. The zone casting below is provisional: it uses the three characters who have voice sheets today, matched to the maths each already talks about. The Relic-station characters (writing/voice-sheets.md, 'Characters still to come') can take over a zone once they have a sheet and a brief. A teacher with no brief cannot be recorded yet.
